title: Sheafified relative differentials and universal derivation
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category essentially small in the universe $w$, let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology on $\mathcal C$, and let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings with values in that universe. Define the sheaf of relative differentials $\Omega_{B/A}$ to be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], in the category of $B$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], of the presheaf $U\mapsto\Omega_{B(U)/A(U)}$ of K\"ahler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], with restriction maps induced by the restrictions of $A$ and $B$. Its universal $A$-derivation $\mathrm d:B\to\Omega_{B/A}$ is the sectionwise universal derivation followed by the module-sheafification unit. Thus $\mathrm d(b)$ is the image of $\mathrm db$ under that unit on every section. In the existing Lean interface, $\operatorname{ring}(B)$ forgets commutativity, $\operatorname{sets}(B)$ and $\operatorname{moduleSets}(B)$ forget to underlying set sheaves using the canonical same-universe lift, $\operatorname{omega}(\varphi)$ is this module sheaf, $\operatorname{derivation}(\varphi)$ is its derivation on the underlying presheaves, and $\operatorname{d}(\varphi)$ is the induced map of the lifted underlying set sheaves.
